item.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal and H.E. Dr. Mohamed Farid Saleh, Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade of Egypt, co-chaired the 7th session of the India–Egypt Joint Trade Committee (JTC) in Egypt’s New Administrative Capital today. The meeting marked the first occasion on which this important bilateral institutional mechanism was convened at the ministerial level,…
item.title: India and Egypt Hold Ministerial-Level 7th Joint Trade Committee Meeting to Strengthen Bilateral Economic Ties
